note: d<N>: throat separation d = |wormhole_centerA - wormhole_centerB| (offsets from `center`; centerB defaults to -centerA, centerA to (0,0,5)); BinaryBH-format params (bbh_control_*): |bh1.offset - bh2.offset|. Integer spelling; the two half-integer probes use the next rule -- untestable in 1: merge_orbit_flip_d12_r05000 (no params)
d65 / d75 = 6.5 / 7.5: decimal point dropped (placement probes only). The spelling is ambiguous in general (d15 could be 1.5 or 15); no other half-integer d exists in the pack

p<NNN>: Bowen-York momentum per throat, p_A = |wormhole_momentumA| (B defaults to -A, so net P = 0); first digit = integer part: p012 = 0.12, p045 = 0.45, p02 = 0.2. Binaries push tangentially (y, orbit in the x-y plane); s20_boost_p02 pushes one throat along z. BinaryBH: |bh1.momentum|

L<NN>: the FULL box side (code units; the cube is [0,L]^3 with the physics at center = L/2). L64 / L128 / L512. A symmetry-reduced box names its full side as L_full (lo_boundary = 2 halves it: the octant run holds [0, L_full/2]^3 with the physics at centre 0), so box_side = L_full when set, else L. BinaryBH alias: geometry.prob_extent[0]
oct: an octant box, mirror planes x = y = z = 0 (lo_boundary = 2 2 2; the launch preflight checks all three and the consumer's --reflect x y z)
zs: zero shift, shift_Gamma_coeff 0 with no initial shift, so beta = 0 throughout (normal coordinates: the grid is not dragged through the fixed refinement boxes)
ladder_L<N> ONLY: L<one digit> is the refinement level of the p012 refinement ladder (restarted from Chk05000), NOT the box (the box token has >= 2 digits)
ml<N>: max_level N (dx_finest = (L/N1)/2^N). Also inside the stage label s16ml3
lvl<N>[from0|chk|down]: max_level N (same meaning as ml<N>; lvl is the merger arms' spelling)
lvl<N>from0: run at max_level N from t = 0, no amr.restart (restart_step None)
lvl<N>chk: the checkpointed twin; writes_checkpoints = checkpoint_interval > 0 AND amr.checkpoint_files_output != 0 (AMReX default 1)
lvl<N>down: down-step -- restarted from a FINER-level checkpoint with max_level lowered to N (merge_headon_flip_d8_v1_lvl3down_t100_r03500: level-5 Chk03500 -> level 3)
n<N>: base-grid cells per side N1 (= N2 = N3). BinaryBH alias: amr.n_cell[0]
s1uni<N>: Stage-1.4 unigrid control with N1 = N
s1uni<N>: unigrid, max_level 0
stage1 / s15: Stage-1 (gauge+dissipation) and Stage-1.5 (fixed-grid tagger) shakedown, max_level 2 (runs_registry.tsv, 01_single_throat block)
t<NNN>: stop_time (code units = M). For a restart leg it is the leg's stop_time. BinaryBH alias: evolution.stop_time. Names without a t token do not encode stop_time

hold: one throat held at its exact static data -- no declared seed (wormhole_seed_amplitude_A = wormhole_seed_l2_amplitude_A = 0)
eta<N>: Gamma-driver shift damping eta = N (production 1.0)
lp<N>: Bona-Masso lapse_power N (1 = 1+log; 2 = harmonic-class d_t alpha = -2 alpha^2 K)
lc<N>: Bona-Masso lapse_coeff N (production 2.0). lc4 exists only as a template

sg<NN>: Kreiss-Oliger sigma with the '.' deleted by run_single.sh (WHM_SIGMA): sg00 = 0.0, sg01 = 0.1, sg10 = 1.0
lapse<N>: initial lapse type (run_single.sh WHM_LAPSE_TYPE): 5 = the drainhole's exact static lapse e^u, 6 = 5 x the origin-isolating collar
fg: fixed nested grids (FixedGridsTagger) -- run_single.sh appends _fg when WHM_TAGGING_TYPE != 0
tl<N>: tagging_L with '.' deleted (run_single.sh WHM_TAGGING_L). No packed run uses it
dt0<NN>: Courant factor dt_multiplier = 0.<NN> (dt005 = 0.05, dt01 = 0.1; production 0.02)
halfstep: dt_multiplier halved, 0.02 -> 0.01
cf<NN>: chi floor min_chi = 1e-NN (floor ladder: cf08 / cf10 / cf12)
chireg: chi regularisation on -- chi_rhs_floor 1e-8 (floor applied only where 1/chi is used)
chireg: ... with the evolved-chi floor lowered to 1e-20
lowfloor: min_chi 5e-10 instead of 1e-8
autopsy: per-cell NaN autopsy report armed
step1: one coarse step only (stop_time is left at the template's value)
chk: rolling checkpoints on (checkpoint_interval > 0 and amr.checkpoint_files_output != 0)

r<NNNNN>: continuation leg restarted from BinaryWormholeChk<NNNNN> (run_single.sh appends _r<step> from WHM_RESTART). restart_step = digits after 'Chk' in amr.restart; a log-only arm without params falls back to launch_banner.txt's '[whm] restart' line

r<NNNNN>: the step is the PARENT's coarse-step count, so t_restart = NNNNN x 0.01 (every parent ran dt = 0.02 x L/N1 = 0.01); checked as first stream row minus one coarse step of the leg (streams restart at t_restart + dt, with no header line) -- untestable in 10: merge_orbit_flip_d12_r05000 (no params); merge_twin_p012_cf12_t060_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); freeze_narrow_late_t080_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L4_damped_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L4_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L5_damped_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L5_halfstep_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L5_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L6_damped_r05000 (no evolution stream packed); ladder_L7_r05000 (no evolution stream packed)
a<N>[N]: throat scale a with '.' dropped (a1 = 1, a15 = 1.5, a3 = 3; production 2). Set equal on B in every packed a-arm

m<NN>: drainhole (ADM) mass m with '.' dropped: m05 = 0.5 (production 1.0); B defaults to A. COLLISION: run_single.sh's own _m<mass> suffix (WHM_BARE_MASS) means wormhole_bare_mass_A/B; no packed run used it and bare mass is 0 in all of them

mu<N>: mass-to-scale ratio mu = m/a = wormhole_drainhole_mass_A / wormhole_throat_radius_A (template params_single_mu2_eps_p1e2_t100: a = 1, m = 2). No packed run; that template's t100 is a-scaled (stop_time 50, 'stop_time 50 here = t 100 at a = 2')
helfer: Helfer/Ning one-body superposition correction on (window auto = d/3 unless w<N>)
plain: plain superposition (the Helfer twins' reference)
w<N>: Helfer window width N (auto = d/3 = 4 at d = 12)
single / stage labels: ONE throat -- throat B removed by wormhole_throat_radius_B = 0 (B defaults to A, so it must be set; SimulationParameters.hpp)
merge / ctrl / place: two throats (wormhole_throat_radius_B > 0) -- untestable in 1: merge_orbit_flip_d12_r05000 (no params)

flip: throat B's scalar profile reversed, phi = phi_A + sigma phi_B with sigma = -1 (opposite scalar charges attract; the merger channel). Default +1 (like charges repel) -- untestable in 1: merge_orbit_flip_d12_r05000 (no params)
twin: the p = 0.12 'twin' series (one-knob twins of the plain flipped merger); the flip is implied, not spelled
headon: no Bowen-York momentum (p_A = |wormhole_momentumA| = 0); pair falls from rest
rest: released from rest (p_A = 0)
place: placement probe -- the head-on scout's pair at rest at separation d, one step (with step1)
orbit / spiral: tangential push p_A > 0 (value in the p<NNN> token); boost: the single boosted throat of Stage 2.0 (P along z) -- untestable in 1: merge_orbit_flip_d12_r05000 (no params)
bbh: vacuum binary-black-hole control -- params in the stock BinaryBH format (bh1.* / bh2.*, amr.*, evolution.*), no scalar; bh1.mass = bh2.mass = 0.9615 (bare puncture mass)
bridge_grtresna: constraint-solved GRTresna data read through ExternalGridInitialData (recipe_initial_data_file set)
nodamp: core matter damping off
damped: core matter damping on (ladder twins)
rw: damping radius window on (core_damping_radius_start > 0 and core_damping_radius_full > 0; rw_r05000: full inside 0.5, off by 0.7, from t = 33)
nofill: interior fill (CoreFreezeFill) off -- the 'unmasked' wall probes

freeze / freeze2 / latefreeze (/ fill, templates only): smooth interior fill on (every RHS x (1 - W(r)) between core_fill_radius_full and _start from core_fill_from_time). freeze2 = the fill-window twin
fillnarrow: head-on fill-radius twin, fill on ...
fillnarrow: ... with radii 1.0 / 1.5 instead of V1c's 1.2 / 1.8
narrow: orbital freeze skin r_full 1.3 / r_start 1.8
wide: orbital freeze skin one cell wider, r_full 1.5 / r_start 2.0
late: fill armed late, t = 55.5 instead of the programme's 53.0 (freeze_narrow_late)
v1: Phase-3 head-on scout family (d = 8 from rest, chi regularisation, autopsy armed) with the fill OFF (the V1 template)
v1c: the V1c late-freeze template (fill armed, t = 26.5 or 25.0) and its twins
v1 / v1c: inherit the scout's chi regularisation (chi_rhs_floor 1e-8, min_chi 1e-20)
v2: the V2 production spiral (L = 128, N = 256; L128 is also spelled out)
prof / mouths: in-code radial core profile on (core_radial_profile.dat)
prof / mouths: the in-code profile was actually written (a binary older than 2026-09-15, e.g. the campaign pin main3d_boost_2026-09-08.ex, ignores core_radial_profile silently)
mouths: consumer run with per-mouth areal radius + horizon scan (profile headon); proxy: the packed horizon_scan.dat exists
scalar: consumer flag --scalar-modes (profiles headon-modes / orbit-modes); not in params; proxy: packed scalar_modes.dat exists (the stream also exists on some runs without the token)
diag: Weyl-extraction diagnostic pass -- raw sphere dumps on (Weyl4_extraction_NNNNNN.dat), no consumer
crosscheck / wave: in-code Weyl4 extraction on (validation against the consumer psi4)
